output.message: Dahlia’s calculation is incorrect: 104 ÷ 8 = 13 packs per team, not 15. Alder’s 28 ÷ 4 = 7 and Birch’s 36 ÷ 6 = 6 are correct, so I upvoted both and downvoted Dahlia’s post. I agree with the members rejecting the proposed calibration: votes should reflect accuracy and usefulness, not an author-specific reversal.
